items.html: And when there is no lower arousal, the coupling is not through this Path, for there are no Mayin Nukvin; and this Path below is the secret of MAN, as we wrote above. And the coupling is not for the need of blessing and freedom, but only for the second bounty, which is endurance and standing alone. And this was when the Holy Temple was destroyed, that the upper Hey was banished, as mentioned in the Tikkunim, with regard to this kind of bounty alone, for there is no day whose curse is greater than the previous one.
